messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer X wants a guaranteed zero-downtime upgrade path for their on‑prem installer, plus ability to hand off network ownership to their NetOps team. Need to scope what we can promise for GA.
alex: Can we define 'zero-downtime' here? rolling agent upgrades with in-place binary swaps, or full node drain?
ben: From sales: they expect no app downtime and no IP changes to customer infra. They're ok with short route convergence windows.
tasha: NetOps handoff typically means we cannot touch their border routers. They want an API to signal 'maintenance window open' and a safe auto-rollback if checks fail.
maria: Good. Let's list launch criteria I'm hearing: 1) in-place rolling upgrades w/ state migration, 2) maintenance-window API, 3) documented rollback path, 4) customer-managed networking docs and checklist. Agree?
alex: +1 but call out KV cache compatibility across versions otherwise sessions break.
ben: Also include a small pilot: 2 customers for GA, one cloud-equivalent and one air-gapped. Sales will line up candidates.
june: We'll need a customer comms pack + runbook for their NetOps. I can draft.
deploy-bot: deploy status: private-distro v0.9.1 candidate built — sha1=ab12... — includes rolling-upgrade hooks.
tasha: Important: for air-gapped installs, upgrades may require offline package transfer. That adds manual steps and longer windows. Is manual acceptable for GA?
maria: Proposal: GA supports automated rolling upgrades for VPC and connected on-prem; air-gapped gets guided/manual upgrade with clear outage expectations. We should seek approval.
alex: Tech caveat: automated rolling requires a handshake service reachable by our controller or local orchestrator managed by customer. Need to list connectivity ports and ephemeral IPs.
ben: Customers will push back on opening egress. Some require proxying through an approved gateway. Include proxy flow in docs.
june: I'll add proxy pattern and template env vars.
alex: Also propose an opt-in 'preserve-session' mode that keeps older runtime available until KV migration succeeds. Adds complexity but helps zero-downtime.
tasha: We should add a readiness probe set customers can run pre-upgrade to validate network, disk, and certs. Example command: `./rwd-agent check --preflight`
maria: Nice. Add that to launch checklist. Also: metrics -- we must report per-upgrade success/failure and rollback events to customers for audit.
ben: Sales ask: SLA language for Dedicated vs Private — define best-effort for Private GA and formal SLAs for Dedicated.
alex: From infra: we need a clear contract for port/IP ownership in the installer config. Example config snippet they can commit to: ```json
{
  "handshake_endpoint": "https://proxy.company.local:8443",
  "maintenance_window": "RFC3339",
  "network_owner": "customer"
}
```
june: I'll put that in the runbook and include a template change-management e-mail.
tasha: Risk callout: if the customer's NetOps reassigns VIPs during upgrade, routing flaps may break streaming sessions. Add mitigation: session draining + reconnect hints.
maria: OK action items: alex — spec KV compatibility and preserve-session mode (ETA 1w). tasha — preflight checks and runbook steps (ETA 3d). june — comms pack + template (ETA 3d). ben — line up 2 pilot customers (ETA 1w). I'll coordinate stakeholder signoff after drafts.
alex: Noted. One more: we should include a kube and non-kube path in the spec. Many customers run bare-metal systemd.
maria: Agreed. Make both explicit.
ben: Anything for pricing/packaging on upgrades? we should clarify included vs paid-assist.
june: Suggest: basic automated upgrades included; air-gapped or assisted field upgrades are billable professional services.
tasha: Sounds reasonable.
deploy-bot: NOTE: create ticket INF-4021 for 'preserve-session mode' and INF-4022 for 'preflight checks'.
maria: Great. We'll review progress in sync on Tuesday. Thanks team :thumbsup:
